{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Seafood|Seafood]] | [[Cookbook:Oyster|Oyster]]

There are several ways to '''stew oysters'''. Two recipes are given below.

== Ingredients ==
*2 dozen (24 [[Cookbook:Each|ea]].) raw, whole [[Cookbook:Oyster|oyster]]s
*2 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] (55 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
*¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Cream|cream]]
*¼ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Mace|mace]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Bay Leaf|bay leaves]]
*[[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]], [[Cookbook:pepper|black pepper]], and [[Cookbook:Nutmeg|nutmeg]], to taste

== Procedure ==
#Shuck the oysters, saving any liquid in the oyster.
#Put your oysters with all their liquid into a [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]]; add the butter, salt, black pepper, mace, and bay leaves.
#Bring to a [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]] for 5 minutes. Add the cream and shake all well together while heating through.
#Pour onto a plate or platter, grating a little fresh nutmeg on each oyster as it lies in the sauce.
